name: Agent approval
oneLiner: a glass agent run card ticks through its steps, then pauses amber on the risky one: an approval request lifts out of the row in 3D, a pointer presses Approve, it turns green and sinks back, and the run finishes with the status flipping to a green Done
say: when the speaker says the agent stops and asks before doing anything risky ('it checks with me before it sends', 'nothing goes out without my OK'): the card lifts on 'asks', the press lands on 'approve', the green Done on the payoff
